responsibility: This header declares gcc::jit::result, the internal implementation class behind gcc_jit_result. It abstracts the platform-specific dynamic-library handle type, exposes lookup of generated code and globals by symbol name, and records ownership of the temporary directory associated with the compiled artifact. It is the interface for managing and querying an in-memory compilation result object.
same_name_distinction: Declares the gcc::jit::result class and its platform-dependent handle type used after JIT compilation. Unlike jit-result.cc, it is the interface that exposes result lifetime and symbol-lookup operations, not the destructor and lookup implementations.
